observation: Front, top and iso inspected together as one contact sheet at 500 px a view. Square tile, thinner than the belt tile so a trapped world drops into a well, with an engraved sunburst on its face and two raised tongues at diagonally opposite corners. Front view shows exactly two tongues, both rooted in the slab, leaning outward; top view shows them at opposite corners and the engraving as line art rather than relief. No third tongue, nothing floating, no tongue inside the seat area.
